startup-shell.action.start.description: Button label that requests browser game startup.

startup-shell.action.use-this-tab.description: Button label that deliberately transfers writable game ownership to the current browser tab.

startup-shell.app-name.description: Game name shown as the top-level heading in the browser startup shell.

startup-shell.boundary.body.defaultMessage: The game display stopped. No automatic retry or progress change was attempted. Reload this page when you are ready.
startup-shell.boundary.body.description: Safety explanation shown by the top-level local render-error boundary.

startup-shell.boundary.title.description: Heading shown by the top-level local render-error boundary.

startup-shell.diagnostics.label.description: Accessible label for a locally redacted technical diagnostic report.

startup-shell.diagnostics.summary.description: Expandable summary label for locally redacted technical diagnostics.

startup-shell.import.overwrite-confirmat.defaultMessage: Import this save and replace the current browser profile? A recovery copy is retained before replacement.
startup-shell.import.overwrite-confirmat.description: Confirmation shown before the player explicitly approves replacing the isolated browser profile with an imported save.

startup-shell.import.text-help.defaultMessage: Paste an exported Idle Dyson Swarm save string. It is checked before your current browser progress can be replaced.
startup-shell.import.text-help.description: Safety guidance for the optional manual save-text recovery field.

startup-shell.import.text-label.description: Visible label for the optional manual save-text recovery field.

startup-shell.operation.export-failed.defaultMessage: Recovery data could not be exported from this tab.
startup-shell.operation.export-failed.description: Assertive, privacy-safe failure status after recovery export fails.

startup-shell.operation.export-pending.description: Polite status while retained recovery data is being exported.

startup-shell.operation.export-succeeded.description: Polite confirmation after retained recovery data is exported.

startup-shell.operation.import-failed.defaultMessage: The save could not be imported. Your existing progress was not replaced.
startup-shell.operation.import-failed.description: Assertive, privacy-safe failure status after a save import fails.

startup-shell.operation.import-pending.description: Polite status announced while a player-approved save import is pending.

startup-shell.operation.import-succeeded.description: Polite confirmation after a player-approved save import succeeds.

startup-shell.operation.reload-completed.description: Polite confirmation when a requested reload has been handed to the browser.

startup-shell.operation.reload-failed.defaultMessage: This tab could not reload safely. Your progress was not reset.
startup-shell.operation.reload-failed.description: Assertive, privacy-safe failure status after safe reload preparation fails.

startup-shell.operation.reload-pending.description: Polite status while the runtime releases ownership before a requested reload.

startup-shell.state.application-blocked..defaultMessage: A required browser feature is unavailable. Your existing progress has not been changed.
startup-shell.state.application-blocked..description: Explanation shown when required browser capabilities are unavailable.

startup-shell.state.application-blocked..defaultMessage: This browser cannot start the game
startup-shell.state.application-blocked..description: Heading shown when required browser capabilities are unavailable.

startup-shell.state.error.body.defaultMessage: Startup stopped without replacing your existing progress.
startup-shell.state.error.body.description: Safety explanation shown when the controlled startup process reports an error.

startup-shell.state.error.title.description: Heading shown when the controlled startup process reports an error.

startup-shell.state.idle.body.defaultMessage: Start when you are ready. Your saved progress is not changed by this screen.
startup-shell.state.idle.body.description: Explanation shown before the browser game startup process begins.

startup-shell.state.idle.title.description: Heading shown before the browser game startup process begins.

startup-shell.state.ownership-lost.body.defaultMessage: Game activity stopped to protect your progress because another tab or window became active.
startup-shell.state.ownership-lost.body.description: Safety explanation shown after this browser tab loses canonical writer ownership.

startup-shell.state.ownership-lost.title.description: Heading shown after this browser tab loses canonical writer ownership.

startup-shell.state.ready-placeholder.bo.defaultMessage: Startup completed. The gameplay surface will appear here.
startup-shell.state.ready-placeholder.bo.description: Temporary explanation shown after startup succeeds but before gameplay UI is connected.

startup-shell.state.ready-placeholder.ti.description: Temporary heading shown after startup succeeds but before the gameplay UI is connected.

startup-shell.state.recovery.body.defaultMessage: The game did not replace the saved progress it could not safely open. Import another save to continue. If that import cannot be used, its retained recovery data can then be exported for support.
startup-shell.state.recovery.body.description: Recovery explanation that promises export only after an attempted import has been retained.

startup-shell.state.recovery.title.description: Heading shown when startup requires a player-directed recovery choice.

startup-shell.state.starting.body.defaultMessage: Checking this browser and preparing your saved progress.
startup-shell.state.starting.body.description: Explanation shown while the browser game startup process is in progress.

startup-shell.state.starting.title.description: Heading shown while browser game ownership and saved progress are being prepared.

startup-shell.state.stopping.body.defaultMessage: Finishing the current operation and releasing this tab.
startup-shell.state.stopping.body.description: Explanation shown while the browser game is completing its stop sequence.

startup-shell.state.stopping.title.description: Heading shown while the browser game is completing its stop sequence.

startup-shell.state.writer-blocked.body.defaultMessage: Another browser context is holding the writable game session. Use this tab to continue here and stop the other context from writing progress.
startup-shell.state.writer-blocked.body.description: Recovery guidance shown when another browser context owns write access.

startup-shell.state.writer-blocked.title.defaultMessage: Another tab is using this game
startup-shell.state.writer-blocked.title.description: Heading shown when another browser tab or window owns write access.
